## Description

<!-- Clearly describe what this PR changes and why. Include relevant context, links to issues, or screenshots if applicable. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature or capability
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] infra — Terraform or AWS infrastructure change
- [ ] docs — documentation only change
- [ ] chore — dependency update, refactor, or housekeeping

## Checklist

- [ ] All tests pass locally (`npm run test`, `pytest tests/`)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, ARNs, account IDs, or internal URLs committed in plain text
- [ ] Terraform code is formatted (`terraform fmt -recursive`)
- [ ] Security impact considered — new IAM permissions are least-privilege, no public exposure added unintentionally
- [ ] Environment variables or GitHub repo variables updated if new config is required
- [ ] `CODEOWNERS` / reviewers assigned if appropriate
